text: だちんを　もっていって　くんな！

structure.jp: もっていって　くんな！
structure.en: take it with you, will you!

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: もっていって　くんな
patterns.explanation: Here くんな is an old-fashioned, folksy form of くれ, a friendly request, not the 'don't' kind of な. もっていってくんな = 'please take it with you'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いく means doing it and going away. もっていって = 'take it along with you'.
